description: For customer complaint, this request form records customer statement, desired resolution, urgency, safety or privacy screen, ownership, response commitment, and remedy limits. use_case: Use the request form during customer complaint intake, investigation, and recovery when the customer complaint record must identify customer account, contact, product or service, transaction, channel, affected location, and prior complaint history. Complete the applicable handoff for approved response, customer confirmation, credit or corrective action, root-cause referral, trend coding, and closure.
